claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brush for being gentle and comfortable for their pets, especially cats and puppies.
Many customers highlight the comfortable, cushioned gel handle and the convenient self-cleaning button for easy cleanup.
Several reviewers report that the brush effectively removes large amounts of shedding and undercoat hair.
Some customers note the brush snags or pulls on matted or long hair, and one reports the gel handle punctured and leaked.
Multiple reviewers mention their pets, including previously reluctant cats, enjoy being brushed with it.
